Cc: accounts@heliomaps.com

Subject: Pilot credits + ask for invoice offset guidance

Hi Evelyn —

Thanks for running the HelioMaps pilot with Redwood — the product team is happy with throughput and the devs are moving to a small production test. Before we finalize next steps, our finance team asked for a formal credit memo (or instruction) to offset the September invoice for the pilot resources.

I've attached a CSV export of the trial usage and a short note on why we think an invoice offset is the simplest path for both sides (HM_Trial_Usage.csv). Can you confirm Redwood's preferred accounting flow: issue a credit memo and net against the September invoice, or process a contra-allowance journal and leave the invoice as-is?

Folks on our side: accounts@heliomaps.com are looped for GL mapping. We need the documentation by 11/05 for our month-end close.

Thanks —
Olivia Barnes
Head of Operations, HelioMaps
accounts@heliomaps.com

Attachment: HM_Trial_Usage.csv (CSV)
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>

Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits + ask for invoice offset guidance

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the prompt and the usage file. Short answer: we can do either, but accounting needs clarity on the treatment so it flows through both companies' books cleanly. My recommendation (and what ops normally executes) is:

- Redwood issues a formal credit memo referencing the original invoice number.
- HelioMaps applies the credit memo against the September invoice (invoice offset).
- For Redwood's internal ledger we will tag the sale as 'promotional contra-allowance' so revenue recognition is unaffected and the credit is recorded as contra-revenue.

Jonas / Neha — can you confirm the GL/line item mapping and whether we need a one-off journal (JE) attached to the credit memo? HelioMaps' accounting asked for a short memo they can keep with their close files.

Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
+1 415-555-0112
From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T13:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot credits + ask for invoice offset guidance

Eve / Neha —

Reviewed the CSV and trial numbers. Proposed treatment for accounting:

1) Issue a credit memo for $12,450 (matches usage line items in attached draft).
2) Account mapping: Credit memo posts to Contra - Promo Allowance (G/L 4302).
3) If HelioMaps applies the credit to a live AR invoice, no additional JE required on their side beyond reclassifying their AR aging; on our side we'll run a one-line JE to reduce recognized revenue if the credit is >60 days after revenue recognition — but this pilot is within the same quarter so it's a contra-revenue posting only.
4) We will include a short narrative on the credit memo: 'Pilot promotional allowance — offset to Invoice 2026-09-1523 per mutual agreement.'

Attachment: proposed_credit_memo_draft.pdf

Aditya — can ops push the credit memo through with Rosie in Billing? If legal needs a sign-off, loop in Contracts but this should be GTM-approved.

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Manager, Revenue Operations
